summary: Nora now checks whether music is actually reaching the room, instead of assuming it is until something tells her otherwise.
details: Nora's belief that a track was playing came from `playback_id is not None`, which is true in five of the audio controller's six states and audible in at most one. On 2026-09-21 that made her announce 'Now playing: Novel Fergus - 胭脂扣' to a real room off a slot that had never produced a sound.

She also asked the controller for status exactly twice in her life — at boot, and after a version conflict. Everything else was event-driven, so a controller that stopped producing audio WITHOUT sending an event, which is precisely what a wedge does, left the belief standing forever: nothing timed out, the queue never advanced, and the only thing that ever noticed was a person in the room.

The measurement is `position_ms`, which is the count of 20ms frames the voice encoder has actually consumed and sent. It cannot advance unless audio moved, so two readings a poll apart answer a question no status string can. A track that reads `playing` with a frozen position is producing silence.

The controller now also serves `autopaused`, `subscribers` and `playable`. An autopaused player has nothing listening to it: ffmpeg keeps decoding, every other field reads healthy, and neither an idle nor an error event ever fires. Both numbers already existed for a log line; serving them is what lets Nora tell that case apart.

Verdicts are OK, WEDGED, ENDED, PAUSED and UNKNOWN, and UNKNOWN is deliberately distinct. 'I could not read the controller' must never collapse into 'it is not playing' — reading an absence of news as good news was the original defect, and a fail-open liveness check would reproduce it one layer up. An unreachable poll keeps the previous reading rather than resetting the position delta, so a blip cannot hand the next poll a free pass.

WEDGED and ENDED both route through the same handler the controller's own stream-failed uses, so a missed event and a wedge are repaired by the path that was already tested: bounded re-resolve, then advance.
limitations: The poll interval is 30 seconds, so a wedge is caught within about a minute rather than instantly.
A first poll cannot convict on a frozen position, because with one sample a track that just began is indistinguishable from one that stopped.
